culture.seo_desc: Discover Pzaz's culture manifesto — our principles, values, and what makes our dream team tick.
culture.manifesto_p1: At Pzaz.io, we believe film culture is as essential as friendship—it connects us, inspires us, and creates shared experiences. That's why we're committed to support the creation and delivery of stories to audiences around the globe.
culture.manifesto_p2: Exceptional customer experiences drive everything we do, and we know that starts with an extraordinary employee culture. That's why we aim to be leaner, faster, more innovative, and better—every single day.
culture.manifesto_p3: If you're considering joining us, take a moment to understand how we operate. Our approach may not suit everyone, but it defines who we are: a team dedicated to insight, innovation, and making an impact.

principles.title: Clarity of Why.
principles.desc: We always know why we do what we do—because clarity inspires and builds trust and loyalty.

principles.title: Consistency of What.
principles.desc: What we do proves what we believe. We deliver top-quality services and aim to exceed expectations at every touchpoint.

principles.title: The Discipline of How.
principles.desc: Innovation drives us. Accountability guides us. Trust sustains us. We deliver what we promise and create groundbreaking solutions.

principles.title: The Cult of Amazement.
principles.desc: We're not just better than average—we aim to amaze. Everyday 'Wow' moments build trust, and occasional 'Pow' moments deepen connections.

culture.culture_p1: At Pzaz, people come first. We thrive on flexibility, creativity, and collaboration, making us a fun, happy and successful organisation.
culture.culture_p2: We value integrity, excellence, respect, inclusion, and teamwork. What sets us apart:
traits: We share information openly and honestly.
We keep only those that show they want it.
culture.values_desc: At Pzaz, our values shape who we reward and retain. If these resonate with you, you'll thrive here:

values.title: Courage.
values.desc: Speak up, take smart risks, and embrace vulnerability for the truth.

values.title: Curiosity.
values.desc: Learn eagerly, think creatively, and seek diverse perspectives.

values.title: Impact.
values.desc: Deliver results, make colleagues better, and prioritize what matters.

values.title: Selflessness.
values.desc: Put Pzaz first, stay open-minded, and help others succeed.

values.title: Passion.
values.desc: Inspire excellence, care deeply, and stay optimistic.

values.title: Integrity.
values.desc: Be authentic, transparent, and respectful. Own mistakes.

values.title: Innovation.
values.desc: Solve hard problems, simplify, and thrive on change.

values.title: Communication.
values.desc: Clear, concise, and open. Listen well, adapt, and give timely feedback.

culture.dream_desc: At Pzaz, our dream team is decentralized yet united by shared goals. We seek individuals who thrive independently but excel collaboratively, embodying a mindset of continuous growth, open feedback, and mutual respect.

dream_team.title: Better.
dream_team.desc: We're always striving to improve, turning every experience into a step toward excellence.

dream_team.title: Capable.
dream_team.desc: It's not just about brilliance—it's about collaboration, creativity, and shared success. Rewards grow with achievements.

dream_team.title: Feedback.
dream_team.desc: Honesty over kindness, respect above all. Open communication fosters constant improvement.

dream_team.title: Stability & Sustainability.
dream_team.desc: We grow together in good times and stand strong in challenges, prioritizing sustainable success over speed.

dream_team.title: Trust.
dream_team.desc: Mutual support and belief in each other's skills drive our collective success.

dream_team.title: Unique.
dream_team.desc: We seek trailblazers—those unafraid of risks and eager to grow with us, shaping the future together.
